messages:
kai: FYI staging GPU nodes are failing to complete bootstrap after the KMS policy tweak. keystore-proxy returns 401 "missing audit header" and kubelet never registers. Anyone else hit this?

meera: seeing it, +1. Logs show: `keystore-proxy: POST /decrypt -> 401 Missing x-audit-id`. The audit-collector normally adds that header but I think the L7 proxy route was removed in yesterday's egress tighten.

oscar: that would explain it. The key policy now requires `aws:RequestHeader/x-audit-id` to allow decrypt. We shipped the policy but missed the audit-proxy route in staging.

kai: minimal tail from one node: ```
[2026-03-23T11:02:12Z] keystore-proxy: POST /decrypt -> 401 Missing x-audit-id
[2026-03-23T11:02:12Z] kubelet: node join failed: decrypt unauthorized
```

sre-oncall: impact: ~10 GPUs delayed across the staging cluster, autoscaler trimmed warmpool. Marking SEV-3. Short-term options: relax key policy for staging region or re-add audit-proxy route.

meera: prefer scoped policy relax for staging only (less blast radius). We can allow decrypt when request-tag `env:staging` is present. Ops trade-off: slightly weaker check vs full route flip.

oscar: agree. I'll open a change to modify the key policy condition to accept missing header for role `arn:aws:iam::...:role/node-bootstrap` when tagged `env=staging`.

change-bot: Created CR-2026-900: "staging KMS policy: accept missing x-audit-id for node-bootstrap role (temp)". Approvers: @oscar, @meera. Auto-expire: 4h. Runbook attached. :white_check_mark:

kai: approved. Patching policy now. Monitoring joins.

meera: nodes are rejoining, deficit dropping from 10 -> 3 in 4m. Good signal. Opening a postmortem ticket to capture root cause and costs (audit events and retry egress).

oscar: action items: (1) add preflight check that validates audit-proxy route before key policy rollouts (P0), (2) add keystore decrypt health-check that runs after L7 changes (P0), (3) inventory key policies that require request headers and centralize gating (P1).

sre-oncall: monitor for 30m and confirm CR auto-expires. If stable, close SEV-3.

kai: note on cost: retry storm spiked audit-shipper egress and caused ~1.4GB extra peering during the window. We'll add exact numbers in PM. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
